messages:
elaine: Hey folks, impromptu LAN planning thread 

matt: Count me in. I'll bring a PS4 pad and an ethernet splitter. 

raju: I have two Steam controllers in a box somewhere, can bring those + USB extension. Also I can pick up 2 large pepperoni. 

hana: I'll bring the Switch + adapters. Also I can bring a surge protector and a bedside lamp for ambient light. 

ops-bot: Room reservation confirmed for Mezzanine B, 7pm-11pm. Facilities will provide recycling bins. 

elaine: Here's a 1-file checklist so we don't duplicate food: https://tinyurl.com/rw-lan-food 

matt: Poll: what time should we start set-up? React with emoji: :clock7: 6:30, :clock8: 7:00, :clock9: 7:30

raju: reacted :clock7:  

hana: 7:00 works for me. 

elaine: Cool. Bring headphones if you want voice chat; office echo is wild. 

matt: Anyone have a spare HDMI switch? My laptop has only USB-C.

raju: I have a USB-C->HDMI dongle and a small HDMI switch, will bring both. 

hana: tagging @matt remember to install offline copies for Rocket League if you want low latency. 

elaine: Great. See y'all Saturday! :pizza:
